script_text: Stop! Taurus, the cosmos is staging a full-on standoff with your wallet and your heart right now. Mars, the planet of raw drive, has stationed in your 5th House of romance and is squaring your ruling planet Venus, who is sitting pretty in your 2nd House of personal resources. This is a tense 90-degree angle creating friction between what you desire and what you can afford. If you are flying solo, a fiery attraction demands attention but promises financial trouble. If you are committed, your partner may suggest a risky investment that sounds too good to be true. In the career sector, Venus under fire means negotiations stall. Expect a surprise bill from your 8th House of debt or taxes popping up after dinner. Do not sign that lease or click that link before 5 PM. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you catch the lunar eclipse hitting your 7th House.
